name: Kyokkou no Marriage
source:
一In [b]that country[/b], there were [b]fairies[/b].

On a continent racing towards modernization, the Religious State of Midier stands out as a heretical anomaly. In this small nation, fairies coexist with humans, while the practice of magic is commonplace. A decade ago, when Midier faced existential threats, powerful entities known as Fairy Brides emerged. Their immense abilities repelled foreign invasions, elevating them to the status of revered heroes.

At the heart of Midier lies Einsel Grand Monastery, which serves dual purposes. Not only is it the headquarters of the fairy-worshipping Holy Church, but it's also the nation's sole academy for training human magicians.

Enter Sreng, a gifted student whose magical prowess surpasses his peers. His exceptional talents have earned him a coveted opportunity: the chance to become the companion of Lia, the most remarkable of all Fairy Brides. Renowned for her saint-like beauty and embodiment of pure justice, Lia is a figure of widespread admiration.

For many, including Sreng, becoming a Fairy Bride's companion represents the ultimate path to heroism. It's a chance to gain the power necessary to protect what one holds dear.

Yet beneath Sreng's noble aspirations lies an unconscious, hidden motive. Unbeknownst to all, including himself, the path he's about to embark upon may lead to Midier's downfall. As the story begins, this grim truth remains concealed, its potential consequences yet to unfold一

[b]More Than Anyone Else, That Bride is the Most Beloved, and Also the Most Hated[/b]

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://www.ensemble-game.com/30.kyokumari/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
一在[b]那个国家[/b]，有[b]妖精[/b]。

在一个正在迈向现代化的大陆上，米迪尔宗教国家作为异端异端脱颖而出。在这个小国里，妖精与人类共存，魔法的修炼也司空见惯。十年前，当米迪尔面临生存威胁时，被称为仙女新娘的强大实体出现了。他们的巨大能力击退了外敌的入侵，使他们成为受人尊敬的英雄。

艾因塞尔大修道院 (Einsel Grand Monastery) 位于米迪尔 (Midier) 的中心，具有双重用途。它不仅是崇拜妖精的神圣教会的总部，也是全国唯一培养人类魔法师的学院。

Sreng登场，他是一位天才学生，其魔法能力超越了同龄人。他非凡的才能为他赢得了令人垂涎的机会：有机会成为所有仙女新娘中最出色的莉亚的伴侣。莉亚以其圣人般的美丽和纯粹正义的化身而闻名，是一位广受钦佩的人物。

对于包括斯伦在内的许多人来说，成为仙女新娘的伴侣代表着英雄主义的终极之路。这是获得保护所珍视之物所需的力量的机会。

然而，在斯伦的崇高抱负之下，隐藏着一个无意识的、隐藏的动机。包括他自己在内的所有人都不知道，他即将踏上的道路可能会导致米迪尔的垮台。随着故事的开始，这个残酷的真相仍然被掩盖，其潜在的后果尚未显现——

[b]那个新娘比任何人都最被爱，也是最被恨[/b]

[翻译编辑自[url=https://www.ensemble-game.com/30.kyokumari/#story]官网[/url]]
